A frac plug is `a downhole tool used in oil and gas wells to temporarily isolate specific wellbore zones during multi-stage hydraulic fracturing` . These tools, often made of composite or dissolvable materials, create a pressure-tight barrier to isolate already fractured stages from new ones, enhancing stimulation efficiency. They are crucial for optimizing, protecting, and allowing for efficient, segmented stimulation of the well, and are typically removed later by drilling or dissolution.[[1]](https://www.halliburton.com/en/completions/well-completions/frac-plugs#:~:text=They%20also%20serve%20as%20check%20valves%20to,sizes%20for%20both%20composite%20and%20dissolvable%20materials.)[[2]](https://www.vertechs.com/news-detail/understanding-frac-plugs-a-key-component-in-well-completion)[[3]](https://eureka.patsnap.com/article/what-is-a-frac-plug-and-how-is-it-used#:~:text=A%20frac%20plug%20is%20a,hydraulic%20fracturing%20process%20is%20complete.)[[4]](https://www.tiktok.com/@fracslap/video/7122645091423964458)

**Key Aspects and Types** 

- **Purpose:** Enables selective stimulation of different zones to boost efficiency.
- **Types:** Composite Frac Plugs (drilled out after use) and Dissolvable Frac Plugs (disintegrate in well fluids).
- **Components:** Usually consist of slips that grip the casing and a rubber element that provides pressure integrity.
- **Operation:** Used in "plug-and-perf" operations where they are set with a wireline and later removed.[[1]](https://www.halliburton.com/en/completions/well-completions/frac-plugs#:~:text=They%20also%20serve%20as%20check%20valves%20to,sizes%20for%20both%20composite%20and%20dissolvable%20materials.)[[2]](https://eureka.patsnap.com/article/what-is-a-frac-plug-and-how-is-it-used#:~:text=A%20frac%20plug%20is%20a,hydraulic%20fracturing%20process%20is%20complete.)[[3]](https://www.wingoil.com/dissolvable-frac-plugs-a-game-changer-in-oil-and-gas-well-fracturing/#:~:text=Dissolvable%20frac%20plugs%20are%20specially,conditions%20after%20the%20fracturing%20operation.)[[4]](https://www.tiktok.com/@fracslap/video/7122645091423964458)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GX-yhj8dm4c&t=46)

**Synonyms/Related Terms** 

- Bridge plug (used for similar, sometimes broader, isolation purposes)
- Downhole plug
- Isolation plug
- Composite plug[[1]](https://www.wingoil.com/dissolvable-frac-plugs-vs-dissolvable-bridge-plugs-how-to-choose-the-right-one/)[[2]](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/matthewcrump1_frac-plug-fact-bridge-plugs-vs-frac-plugs-activity-7301239798185213952-BbDc#:~:text=%E2%9A%93%20Slip%20Design%20&%20Drill-Out,1%20Reaction)

**Usage Examples** 

- **Multistage Fracturing:** Used to isolate each zone consecutively in horizontal wells.
- **Zone Stimulation:** Provides a seal to allow high-pressure fluids to be directed to a specific target.
- **Wellbore Cleanup:** Used to facilitate clean up after fracturing.
- **High-Risk Wells:** Specifically designed to reduce the risk associated with traditional intervention techniques.[[1]](https://www.repeatprecision.com/tools/purplereign-dissolvable-frac-plug#:~:text=PurpleReign%E2%84%A2%20gives%20you%20the,of%20temperature%20and%20fluid%20environments.)[[2]](https://www.wingoil.com/dissolvable-frac-plugs-vs-dissolvable-bridge-plugs-how-to-choose-the-right-one/)[[3]](https://www.vertechs.com/news-detail/understanding-frac-plugs-a-key-component-in-well-completion)[[4]](https://www.wingoil.com/differences-between-dissolvable-frac-plugs-and-disintegrating-frac-plugs/#:~:text=is%20it%20Essential?-,Understanding%20What%20Is%20the%20Frac%20Plug,materials%20and%20mechanisms%20for%20disintegration.)[[5]](https://www.halliburton.com/en/completions/well-completions/frac-plugs#:~:text=They%20also%20serve%20as%20check%20valves%20to,sizes%20for%20both%20composite%20and%20dissolvable%20materials.)
